title: Arcane Spell Shop
description: A mystical arcane shop interior with deep purple walls filled with framed magical artworks, including stasis spells, locked fusions, green moths, and alchemical symbols. A woman with red hair and a purple Victorian dress stands at a wooden desk, casting a spell that projects a glowing circular image of two figures while writing in a large illuminated book.
prompt: A detailed fantasy illustration of a mystical arcane shop with deep purple walls covered in ornate framed artworks showing geometric magic circles, green moths, and alchemical diagrams. A beautiful woman with red hair wearing a purple Victorian dress and red headband stands at a wooden desk, one hand casting a glowing circular spell projection showing two figures, while her other hand writes in a large open illuminated book. Lanterns, potion bottles, and magical artifacts fill the scene in a rich, atmospheric style.
